visual.description: A close-up of a man's hand pointing directly toward the camera with a dark, moody background.

vo.en: Place your hand flat on a table. Now, tuck your middle finger all the way under your palm.

visual.description: Macro shot of a male hand on a dark wooden surface, folding the middle finger underneath the palm.

vo.en: Try lifting your thumb and index finger. Easy, right? Now, try lifting your ring finger.

visual.description: Close up of a hand where the thumb and index lift smoothly, but the ring finger remains stuck.

vo.en: Wait until you feel the tension. It’s like your finger is paralyzed, but here’s the creepy part.

visual.description: Abstract blue and yellow digital glitch overlay over a silhouette of a person's head.

vo.en: Your middle and ring fingers share the same extensor digitorum tendon. When one is tucked, the other locks.

visual.description: A clean 3D medical animation showing the internal tendons and muscles of a moving human hand.

vo.en: It’s a physical hardware glitch in your anatomy. Your brain sends the signal, but the mechanics fail.

visual.description: A man looking at his own hand with a look of pure confusion and disbelief.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment GLITCH if you failed, which is exactly why...

visual.description: Overhead shot of a person's thumb scrolling rapidly through a social media feed on a smartphone.
